_label: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLES. Hand-written by Member 3 to show the Annex D audit shape (api/models.py AuditRecord). They are NOT output of the running backend, were not produced by any real request, and every number, ID and timestamp is invented. Replace with real records from GET /audit/{trace_id} once the backend runs.
_schema: AuditRecord: trace_id, timestamp, student_id, question_category, sources_retrieved, precedence_decision, tools_invoked, answer_type, model, llm_calls, tokens, latency_ms (no raw question text).
_assumptions: sources_retrieved is a list of objects; the frozen contract only says list[dict], so the keys inside (doc_id, section, version, effective_from) are an assumption.
tools_invoked items follow ToolInvocation (tool, input, output); the frozen contract only says list[dict].
model is shown as the planned local model name; the team has not confirmed it.
S1001, CS201 and the rule value are placeholders pending Member 2's seed data.

records.precedence_decision: SYN-CIRC-ATT-80 applies: effective on the as-of date and explicitly supersedes SYN-REG-ATT-75 section 4.1 (level 2 supersedes level 1 text it names). SYN-FAQ-ATT-65 (level 5, informational) ignored.
